verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada is an online filing service that holds corporate and user data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for it. The evidence pack covers incorporation steps, fees, filing channels, annual returns, access permissions and email notices, but nothing on retention periods or user-controlled deletion. The access-manager permissions and the ability to change director or office information are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
